Post-dural puncture headache is typically positional and lacks such imaging findings; epidural hematoma is biconvex and hyperdense, contradicting the layered hypodense crescent.

rejected.why: Headache is nonpositional and unrelieved by rest, and imaging shows a subdural collection, not a post-dural puncture headache.
